aggregate.distribution_note: n=1; a single committed console trace yields one command->electrical event, so median=P95=max by construction - this is not yet a distribution

command_to_electrical.latency_exclusion_rule: Onset is the FIRST post-command SAMPLE at or above the current threshold - it is never forced to skip the first sample. A sample is annotated as a stale pre-run PZEM register read ONLY when the record itself carries that evidence (a sub-poll `elapsed_ms`, i.e. the pre-ramp reading documented at evidence/A/W04/h6/41-h6-run-analysis.md:28); such an annotated sample is below threshold in practice, so the annotation never shifts a real onset. CLOCK: the bracket column `host_uptime_s` is the DEVICE LOG UPTIME (seconds since boot in the console line), not a host wall clock. The interval starts at the device's 'START accepted' line, NOT at the operator keystroke (">>> START"), so the ~0.156 s operator-to-accept transport/echo segment is EXCLUDED. The reported delay is command-accept -> electrical-onset, quantised to the 1 Hz poll: the true onset lies within +/-1 s (one poll period) of the reported value.

boot_continuity.note: capture carries no boot_id column; boot continuity is UNVERIFIED

command_to_thermal.method: raw first-crossing, no filter/smoothing; baseline = mean of first 5 fully-valid driven frames
command_to_thermal.note: anchored on the applied-on frame inside the capture, not a host command; the console command->applied hop is a separate (network) gap

cooling_tau.limitation: uses the observed endpoints as the swing; a run that has not reached steady state under-estimates tau
cooling_tau.method: first-order 63.2%-of-observed-swing time constant (proxy, not an ODE fit)
cooling_tau.slope_method: ordinary least squares over the full driven window on the trio mean

data_gap_register.closes_with: supervised S2 door-disturbance capture under the frozen critical definition
data_gap_register.why: no door-open event in any committed capture

data_gap_register.closes_with: a transport decision with Member C and an authorized energized session
data_gap_register.why: production firmware has no network command path (output stage compiled out)

data_gap_register.closes_with: additional clean START traces converted to the H6 schema, then re-run
data_gap_register.why: one committed console trace yields one command->electrical event; H7 run logs live in a sibling commissioning worktree (read-only), not in this branch

door_to_critical.reason: no door-open event exists in any committed capture (door_open is only '0' or 'UNKNOWN', door_polarity has no confirmed-open state); a door->critical trajectory distribution requires an actual door-open disturbance that was never recorded
door_to_critical.what_would_close_it: a supervised S2 door-disturbance capture under the frozen candidate critical definition (docs/05A A-W13-03) - a physical action, so BLOCKED_HARDWARE from the host

passive_proxy.method: first-to-last trio delta (near-equilibrium; no tau asserted)
passive_proxy.note: a passive tau is not reported because the passive signal does not exhibit a first-order swing; inventing one would violate A-W13-04

recovery_tau.compliance_docs01: recovery measured after the defined action per section 20.6
recovery_tau.limitation: uses the observed endpoints as the swing; a run that has not reached steady state under-estimates tau
recovery_tau.method: first-order 63.2%-of-observed-swing time constant (proxy, not an ODE fit)
